name: KALIUM CHLORICUM
key_symptoms: Feeling of weight in epigastric and umbilical region. Flatulence. Vomiting of greenish-black matter.
guiding_symptoms: Feeling of weight in epigastric and umbilical region. Flatulence. Vomiting of greenish-black matter.
head_symptoms: Profuse secretion of acid saliva. Whole mucous surface red, tumid, with gray-based ulcers. Tongue swollen. Stomatitis-aphthous and gangrenous. Fetor. Mercurial stomatitis (as a mouth wash).
gi_symptoms: Feeling of weight in epigastric and umbilical region. Flatulence. Vomiting of greenish-black matter.
skin_symptoms: Jaundice. Itching miliary or papular eruptions. Discolored; chocolate tint.

source.title: KALIUM CHLORICUM - HOMOEOPATHIC MATERIA MEDICA - By William BOERICKE
